root_cause.text: The q6apm component's remove callback destroys child DAI components' runtime data (RTDs) before those child components are themselves removed from the card, leaving dangling pointers that cause a NULL dereference when the card is rebound.
root_cause.evidence: Commit message states: "On ADSP stop, the q6apm-audio .remove callback unloads topology and removes PCM runtimes during ASoC teardown. This deletes the RTDs that contain the q6apm DAI components before their removal pass runs, leaving those components still linked to the card and causing crashes on the next rebind." The patch adds `remove_order` fields: `SND_SOC_COMP_ORDER_EARLY`/`FIRST` for the child DAI components and `SND_SOC_COMP_ORDER_LAST` for the parent q6apm component, enforcing removal of children before parent.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix potential cleanup ordering issue by explicitly setting remove_order to EARLY for the Q6APM front-end DAI component.
intent_record.what: Added assignment of 'remove_order' field to 'SND_SOC_COMP_ORDER_EARLY' in the q6apm_fe_dai_component structure.
intent_record.how: This sets the removal order of the component driver so that it is removed earlier during component teardown, preventing ordering conflicts with dependent components.

intent_record.intent_summary: Set the component driver's remove order to FIRST to ensure proper cleanup ordering during removal.
intent_record.what: Added initialization of the 'remove_order' field to 'SND_SOC_COMP_ORDER_FIRST' in the static const snd_soc_component_driver structure 'q6apm_lpass_dai_component'.
intent_record.how: This sets the component removal order to first, ensuring that this component is removed before other components during driver unregistration or system suspend/resume, which prevents potential dependency issues during cleanup.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add removal ordering to the audio component to fix potential teardown issues by ensuring it is removed last.
intent_record.what: Added `.remove_order = SND_SOC_COMP_ORDER_LAST` field initialization to the `q6apm_audio_component` static const struct definition.
intent_record.how: This controls the order in which the component is removed relative to other components; setting it to `LAST` ensures it is removed after all other components, preventing potential use-after-free or resource conflicts during teardown.

commit 5477518b8a0e8a45239646acd80c9bafc4401522
Author: Srinivas Kandagatla <srini@kernel.org>
Date:   Tue Oct 26 12:16:48 2021 +0100

    ASoC: qdsp6: audioreach: add q6apm support
    
    Add support to q6apm (Audio Process Manager) component which is
    core Audioreach service running in the DSP.
    
    Signed-off-by: Srinivas Kandagatla <srinivas.kandagatla@linaro.org>
    Reviewed-by: Pierre-Louis Bossart <pierre-louis.bossart@linux.intel.com>
    Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/2021102
bic_trace_step.reason: The commit introduces the q6apm component driver with a remove callback (q6apm_audio_remove) that calls snd_soc_tplg_component_remove(component). This function destroys child DAI components' runtime data (RTDs) before those child components are removed from the card, leading to dangling pointers and a NULL dereference on rebind. The vulnerable construct is present and no fix is included.
